      "kidney_guide_filtration_label": "1. Filtration",
      "kidney_guide_filtration_short": "Blood to Bowman capsule",
      "kidney_guide_filtration_detail": "Blood pressure pushes water and small solutes across the glomerular filtration barrier into Bowman capsule. Blood cells and most proteins remain in the circulation.",
      "kidney_guide_reabsorption_label": "2. Reabsorption",
      "kidney_guide_reabsorption_short": "Tubule to blood",
      "kidney_guide_reabsorption_detail": "The proximal tubule returns most filtered water and sodium, plus nearly all glucose and amino acids, to nearby peritubular capillaries.",
      "kidney_guide_secretion_label": "3. Secretion",
      "kidney_guide_secretion_short": "Blood to tubule",
      "kidney_guide_secretion_detail": "Tubule cells move selected ions, medications, and metabolic wastes from the capillary blood into the tubular fluid, helping regulate pH and composition.",
      "kidney_guide_urine_label": "4. Urine formation",
      "kidney_guide_urine_short": "Collecting duct to ureter",
      "kidney_guide_urine_detail": "The loop of Henle builds a medullary concentration gradient. The distal tubule and collecting duct make final hormone-guided adjustments before urine enters the renal pelvis and ureter.",
      "kidney_guide_show_clinical": "Clinical lens",
      "kidney_guide_hide_clinical": "Hide clinical lens",
      "kidney_guide_clinical_shown": "Clinical lens shown.",
      "kidney_guide_clinical_hidden": "Clinical lens hidden.",
      "kidney_guide_clinical_title": "Glomerular barrier injury",
      "kidney_guide_clinical_change": "The filtration barrier becomes abnormally permeable and allows protein to enter the filtrate.",
      "kidney_guide_clinical_effect_heading": "Functional consequence",
      "kidney_guide_clinical_effect": "Urinary protein loss can reduce plasma oncotic pressure and contribute to edema.",
      "kidney_guide_clinical_note": "Educational comparison only — not a diagnostic view."

      "kidney_guide_focus_urine": "Anse de Henlé · Gradient médullaire · Canal collecteur",
      "kidney_guide_filtration_label": "1. Filtration",
      "kidney_guide_filtration_short": "Du sang à la capsule de Bowman",
      "kidney_guide_filtration_detail": "La pression sanguine pousse l’eau et les petits solutés à travers la barrière de filtration glomérulaire dans la capsule de Bowman. Les cellules sanguines et la plupart des protéines restent dans la circulation.",
      "kidney_guide_reabsorption_label": "2. Réabsorption",
      "kidney_guide_reabsorption_short": "Du tubule au sang",
      "kidney_guide_reabsorption_detail": "Le tubule proximal renvoie la majeure partie de l’eau et du sodium filtrés, ainsi que la quasi-totalité du glucose et des acides aminés, vers les capillaires péritubulaires voisins.",
      "kidney_guide_secretion_label": "3. Sécrétion",
      "kidney_guide_secretion_short": "Du sang au tubule",
      "kidney_guide_secretion_detail": "Les cellules tubulaires transportent certains ions, médicaments et déchets métaboliques du sang capillaire vers le liquide tubulaire, ce qui contribue à réguler le pH et la composition.",
      "kidney_guide_urine_label": "4. Formation de l’urine",
      "kidney_guide_urine_short": "Du canal collecteur à l’uretère",
      "kidney_guide_urine_detail": "L’anse de Henlé crée un gradient de concentration médullaire. Le tubule distal et le canal collecteur effectuent les derniers ajustements sous le contrôle des hormones avant que l’urine n’entre dans le pelvis rénal et l’uretère.",
      "kidney_guide_show_clinical": "Perspective clinique",
      "kidney_guide_hide_clinical": "Masquer la perspective clinique",
      "kidney_guide_clinical_shown": "Perspective clinique affichée.",
      "kidney_guide_clinical_hidden": "Perspective clinique masquée.",
      "kidney_guide_clinical_title": "Lésion de la barrière glomérulaire",
      "kidney_guide_clinical_change": "La barrière de filtration devient anormalement perméable et laisse les protéines entrer dans le filtrat.",
      "kidney_guide_clinical_effect_heading": "Conséquence fonctionnelle",
      "kidney_guide_clinical_effect": "La perte de protéines dans les urines peut réduire la pression oncotique plasmatique et contribuer à l’œdème.",
      "kidney_guide_clinical_note": "Comparaison éducative uniquement — ce n’est pas une vue diagnostique."

      "kidney_guide_focus_urine": "Asa de Henle · Gradiente medular · Conducto colector",
      "kidney_guide_filtration_label": "1. Filtración",
      "kidney_guide_filtration_short": "De la sangre a la cápsula de Bowman",
      "kidney_guide_filtration_detail": "La presión sanguínea empuja el agua y los solutos pequeños a través de la barrera de filtración glomerular hacia la cápsula de Bowman. Las células sanguíneas y la mayoría de las proteínas permanecen en la circulación.",
      "kidney_guide_reabsorption_label": "2. Reabsorción",
      "kidney_guide_reabsorption_short": "Del túbulo a la sangre",
      "kidney_guide_reabsorption_detail": "El túbulo proximal devuelve la mayor parte del agua y del sodio filtrados, además de casi toda la glucosa y casi todos los aminoácidos, a los capilares peritubulares cercanos.",
      "kidney_guide_secretion_label": "3. Secreción",
      "kidney_guide_secretion_short": "De la sangre al túbulo",
      "kidney_guide_secretion_detail": "Las células tubulares transportan ciertos iones, medicamentos y desechos metabólicos desde la sangre capilar hacia el líquido tubular, lo que ayuda a regular el pH y la composición.",
      "kidney_guide_urine_label": "4. Formación de la orina",
      "kidney_guide_urine_short": "Del conducto colector al uréter",
      "kidney_guide_urine_detail": "El asa de Henle crea un gradiente de concentración medular. El túbulo distal y el conducto colector realizan los ajustes finales bajo el control hormonal antes de que la orina entre en la pelvis renal y el uréter.",
      "kidney_guide_show_clinical": "Perspectiva clínica",
      "kidney_guide_hide_clinical": "Ocultar la perspectiva clínica",
      "kidney_guide_clinical_shown": "Perspectiva clínica visible.",
      "kidney_guide_clinical_hidden": "Perspectiva clínica oculta.",
      "kidney_guide_clinical_title": "Lesión de la barrera glomerular",
      "kidney_guide_clinical_change": "La barrera de filtración se vuelve anormalmente permeable y permite que las proteínas entren en el filtrado.",
      "kidney_guide_clinical_effect_heading": "Consecuencia funcional",
      "kidney_guide_clinical_effect": "La pérdida de proteínas en la orina puede reducir la presión oncótica plasmática y contribuir al edema.",
      "kidney_guide_clinical_note": "Solo una comparación educativa — no es una vista diagnóstica."
